notes.title: Enemies and Items Update
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1]Enemies are the primary way you interact with the game and it has gotten rather stale. The purpose of this update was to overhaul the way enemies work and hopefully, create more fun gameplay as you shoot and blow them up.

In addition, this update has fixes for movement, RNG, and using every single item simultaneously.

[h1]New Items[/h1]Loads of new items that have explosions, slight gravity, cluster bombs, laser rays, flamethrowers, and more! Hold down right click when making a new game to launch yourself into sandbox mode and gain access to all the items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/edb9229a37d210367a2d7e2635151f250f4081c6.gif[/img]

[h1]Custom Enemies[/h1]Dark Order enemies no longer use the same items that you have access to and you cannot receive these items without creative mode, although there are plans to do so for another update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/b5aa7ea8097518f030c7820ffeb70edc9290fbd9.gif[/img]


[h1]Realm Bosses[/h1]With new items come special realm bosses that vary slightly each run. Realm bosses get a new type of weapon: colossal weapons! They are much larger than the normal weapons, and must be countered differently, forcing you to identify their weaknesses and swap up your playstyle!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/fc051a3b8654841efce11c411f9189ffb2b03699.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/fc051a3b8654841efce11c411f9189ffb2b03699.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Destruction Damage[/h1]
Enemies can hurt you, even after they have been destroyed! Watch out for their core explosions and their falling islands!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/060040344cc0af4d22256d44889e3a59272c5595.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/060040344cc0af4d22256d44889e3a59272c5595.gif[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/3034721f9de259ab728b34a6000b51fa73ebc98f.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/3034721f9de259ab728b34a6000b51fa73ebc98f.gif[/img][/url]


[h1]Item Info Boxes[/h1]Colorful stat bars now give you a quick way to gauge the power of an item! For the number nerds, you can press shift to view the actual numbers as well.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/eec866b7a5be6ddde3ec0577c9618ffc348de3f9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/c129d9982719bbf6d7bd13fe01cbba380be7879c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/01ec56ee7ea68b1de9d2c774413ba7bdd32f557e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/0d2e9f1f3952ed670291fcc5e3a8b5d435bd0959.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/9d12ca69de1701de62bca049f74034fe4d28255b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/12fe8aba668e17a48301d0f897aa28f048e53a85.png[/img][/url]

The forge also has some cool animations for visualizing the changes in stats.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/60e24038a2d913b7be10be7f5e590603c6b4c761.gif[/img]

[h1]Island Stats[/h1]Like the item info boxes, but for your island! Quickly see an overview of the most important parts of your island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/26d765b65a78352b203bcc388b77f27ef1c88188.gif[/img]

[h1]Warp Mass[/h1]The game has struggled with balance for a few reasons, one of them being that you can place whatever you want on your island without restriction, leading to massive islands with extremely large amounts of firepower. While it's fun to blast your 30 cannons at the enemies, it gets boring really quick. 

Warp mass, measured in quatta, limits the number of items you can place on your island. Every block uses 3 quatta and weapons start at 6 quatta and increases its quatta use as you level them up. If your island exceeds the limit, you will not be able to build your island in survival mode.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1][list][*]Forging an item to increase the tier increases its stats significantly
[*]Forge percentages are now based on the current stats instead of the default stats
[*]Forge minimum and maximum stat limits removed
[*]Realm bosses always drop a movement item
[*]Enemies health and damage scale for the different realms to create a balanced and challenging experience
[*]Enemies can have modifiers to change their generation factors to have more weapons, armor, and shields, or blocks (among other things)
[*]Enemies take up a certain amount of space to limit the number of powerful enemy islands that can spawn in a single region at a time
[*]Enemies no longer lose their aggro on you, although moving too far away from them will cause them to deactivate (and do nothing)
[*]Any enemy that is aggro'd on you will prevent you from editing your island, which prevents you from editing and rebuilding your island in the middle of a hostile region
[*]Enemy movement and behavior has been radically improved simply simulate movement instead of actually using normal movement mechanics, allowing them to have greater control over their position
[*]Added cool item properties like charge effects, allowing items to modify themselves as seen in the chainguns modifying their rate of fire.
[*]New realm 9 boss!
[*]Projectiles moved to their own data structure, allowing them to have tertiary or quaternary projectiles
[*]Removed the laser trigger tech
[*]Your island gets rebuilt when revisiting the editor
[*]Major save file changes, both for players and enemies.
[*]Console command to go into freecam
[*]A bunch of other changes that are not as cool as these ones...
[/list]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]GameMaker has released a new version with a lot of lit features in the past few months. I am going to be porting the game over to this new version as well as taking the time to clean up, document, and optimize parts of the game so that it runs better for everyone. I'm expecting this to take a week, but given my awful estimates on time, this could drag out for a month.

After that, I would like to improve some aspects of the UI and interactions with it, specifically the map, shop and forge. School is starting up again in September, and I'm hoping to finish these smaller changes before starting another longer update during the next school semester to be ready by Christmas!

If you want to get access to test versions of these updates, join the Discord server! We will also be having a massive faction war in there soon, with at least a hundred islands battling it out in a simulated environment!

Let me know what the next major update should be in the comments: Persistence Update, Enemies Update II, Environment Update, Drones Update, or something else entirely! I try and listen to the community as much as possible!

notes.title: April Fools Limited Time Event
notes.content:
What could have possibly gone wrong if I opened up suggestions for this April Fools Event to anyone in the Discord server? Turns out, it was a huuugee success and the game got some crazy changes just for fun! This event will be lasting till April 4th, and changes will be reverted back to normal.

[b]Warning: this version of the game contains rainbow colors and excessive screen shake. While there are no rapidly flashing images, it still may cause discomfort for those with photosensitive epilepsy.[/b]

[h1]Development[/h1]The entire development of this update was livestreamed on Youtube. Check out the following links if you are interested!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1qTddCfZbRU
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nKqDmELi9kM

[h1]Temporary Changes[/h1]
Warning, spoilers ahead. These changes will be reverted back to the normal once this event is over.
[list][*]Islands are constructed upside down
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/44202a88a08f801abf6ce27bdae26b63f3ed524c.gif[/img]
[*]Most item sprites have been flattened
[*]Sky color is light pink
[*]Projectiles are the actual weapon that was fired
[*]Projectiles spin and rotate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/7d09c5cd39553bf7f2ed44bfeb51aca93b670f35.gif[/img]
[*]Added a Youtube button to the menu that takes you to the development of this event
[*]Changed the discord link to promote factions
[*]Excessive amounts screenshake
[*]Hit sounds changed to rubber duck squeaky noises
[*]Warp gates have a random color
[*]Realm gates have a rainbow color
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944008/41a377f73008452ce371eeac408cd5ab87313d77.gif[/img]
[*]Enemies are outlined in green
[*]Friendlies are outlined in red
[*]Loading text changed to "infesting your computer"
[*]Menu logo oscillates fast
[*]Menu logo has a rainbow cloud
[*]Tutorial boss changed
[/list]

[h1]Permanent Changes[/h1]These suggestions were so great that some form of them will remain in the game after this event is finished.
[list][*]Player acceleration and speed increased
[*]Screenshake will be reduced but still remain
[*]Warp and realm gates rotate round the portal
[/list]

[h1]Secret Changes[/h1]Warning, even more spoilers ahead. Turn back now if you want to be surprised!
[list][*][spoiler]Build area increased to 13x13, however, only visual changes were made to make it look like you have extra space. You still have a 12x12 build area.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]The news button send you to a very special youtube video[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]A massive random explosion will spawn every 5-10 minutes[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Some houses may look like a giant blue cup or a giant rubber duck[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Mortars fire downward and have upwards gravity[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h1]Unintentional Changes[/h1]No such thing as bugs in this version, only unintentional features.
[list][*]Spykes face toward your island on the horizontal axis
[*]Mortars wont rotate
[*]Game eats your computer's resources like a ravaging shark (nom nom)
[/list]

I had a blast making some of these changes and I'm looking forward to future events like these for public holidays in the future!

notes.title: Enemies Rework - Phase 1
notes.content:
The biggest issue with the game is enemies. They all behave the same way and just end up being the same thing to the player: cannon fodder with no real strategy. This update is the first phase of a series of updates that will attempt to fix them.

[h1]Enemy Changes[/h1]
[h3]Behavior[/h3]Enemy classes now have special behavior patterns created for them, depending on their type of class. Some classes circle around you, others like to poke in and out, and some like the bomber class just want to move up and down. These behaviors are modularly built so that I can easily create cool patterns from simple commands.

[h3]Generation[/h3]While the island generation seemed alright for the most part, the classes themselves weren't incredibly balanced. In addition, sometimes enemies didn't spawn with weapons at all, so those issues were fixed as well.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
In an effort to make things more active and shooty, items have been adjusted. Some parts of your current items will not be affected but all new items will have these new changes.

[list][*]Energy weapons now deal extra damage to shields instead not dealing any damage at all. As later game items, it didn't make sense that they could be countered so hard by such an easy to acquire item like shields, and effectively rendering them completely useless. Now that energy weapons are extremely effective against shields, enemies can now just have energy weapons, though you won't see any because there aren't any energy enemy classes just yet.
[*]Quickshots, shotguns, lasers and autolasers have had their rotation speed increased to match their faster playstyle.
[*]Rockets rotation speed decreased, but has a significant amount more homing rotation.
[*]Gravity, acceleration, and deceleration speeds all significantly increased. This will hopefully make the island more responsive to your controls.
[*]Basic aerodynamic system implemented to promote not building rectangles. This is calculated based on your maximum dimensions to determine how rectangular the island is. Rectangular or vastly empty islands get a small movement speed penalty while building more triangular islands will give you an increase to movement speed.
[*]Enemies have fixed movement penalties to prevent them from flying all over the place and make them easier and more predictable to track down.
[*]Adjusted the weight of certain region types like cities to be more balanced out.
[*]Map invasion starts slightly farther back to give you an extra jump or two to hit those regions surrounding your spawn region.
[*]Final boss is harder.
[/list]

[h1]Technical Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Items will now use the sprite property
[*]Pressing F4 will execute the last console command, even if you do not have the console open.
[*]Added an editor_generate_random command to generate enemy classes
[*]Added and enemies command to view the different enemy classes
[/list]

notes.title: Map Tweaks
notes.content:
This small update has a few changes and tweaks to the map. The idea of moving towards the center of the realm wasn't quite working as well as I intended. Most of the time regions on the opposite side of the gate region would be left untouched and were rather useless.

So, I moved the gate region from the center of the map to opposite the starting region, hopefully allowing you to explore more and opening up more possibilities by increasing the distance between the where you start and where you need to go.

[h3]Realm[/h3][list][*]realm gate spawn on the opposite side of the map from your starting region
[*]starting region is always a passage
[*]increased speed of the invasion so you need to be at the gate within 9 jumps (from 11)
[*]passage regions no longer spawn normally
[*]tweaked the distribution of the different region types
[/list]
[h3]Region[/h3][list][*]hostile regions descreased in size
[*]outpost regions (!) have 3-4 enemies
[*]blockade regions (!!) have 5-6 enemies
[*]invaded regions (!!!) have 7-8 enemies
[/list]
